prompt: A cozy, rustic log cabin interior at night. A large stone fireplace has a burning log, casting a warm glow. In front of it, a handmade woven rug lies on the wooden floor. A simple log chair and a wooden table are nearby. On the table, an old oil lamp illuminates a tin coffee pot and a single mug. A heavy, checkered blanket is draped over the back of the chair. A fishing rod leans in the corner next to a small axe stuck in a chopping block. A pair of worn hiking boots is on the floor by the door. On the wall hangs a hunting trophy of deer antlers and a topographical map. A small backpack is propped against the wall. It's a retreat from the modern world, so you will not find a television or a personal computer. The heat comes from the fire, not an electric heater, and there are no plastic water bottles or modern magazines in sight. This is a wild place, devoid of any houseplant.
